plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-16 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). The map is headed 'Police Science map for 2026-2027' and the pathway is for catalog year 2026-2027. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. Card View and Table View agreed exactly on every fixed course, category, unit value and term total; the printed wording of choice-slot headings differs between the views on this map, so slot titles below use the Card View wording and each slot's note also gives its Table View wording. The inventoried program 'Police Science' is listed in the mapper under that name (the program details text spells it 'Police Sciences'); the program details state the student will be awarded an Associate of Science degree and describe coursework as 'A minimum of 61 semester units in the major'. This plan transcribes the first-listed 2026-2027 pathway, 'Bakersfield College / Police Science / Associate of Science / 61-63.5 units / 4 terms / to CSU', in full; the page shows only the 4-term Bakersfield College segment, with no CSU course segment. The program's second 2026-2027 pathway ('to Degree', 60-61.5 units, 4 terms, term totals 15-16.5 / 15 / 15 / 15) uses the Bakersfield College general-education pattern rather than the CalGETC pattern and is not collected as a separate plan. In 2025-2026 both pathways existed in 6 terms at the same unit totals. The transcribed map prints term totals as 15-16.5 / 15 / 15 / 16-17. Ranged rows: Term 1 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5); Term 4 first 'Area 4 : Social and Behavioral Sciences' (3-4). Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged row is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 61 units. CRIM B1 and CRIM B5 are printed with the dual category label 'Major / Gen Ed'; they are named major courses and are recorded with category 'major'. The 'Area 4 : Social and Behavioral Sciences' slot is printed twice in Term 4 and is recorded as a separate choice slot in each occurrence exactly as printed. No row on the map shows a 'Prerequisites', 'Corequisites' or 'Dual Enrollment' flag in Card View, so no prereqs are recorded. General-education slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. No separate Certificate program named Police Science exists in the mapper. The map page states verbatim: 'Program maps are for reference only. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan or visit CSU Transfer Planner for more options.'
